label: G.652.D loose-tube 72F
notes: Six tubes of 12, TIA-598 tube colours 1-6. Attenuation here is typical installed performance, not a G.652.D limit: 0.35 dB/km at 1310 nm sits under the recommendation's 0.40 dB/km maximum (1310-1625 nm), and 0.21 dB/km at 1550 nm under its 0.30 dB/km maximum (1530-1565 nm). 1490 nm is a typical, interpolated value: no ITU-T recommendation publishes a 1490 nm attenuation figure of its own (G.652.D's 0.40 dB/km maximum spans 1310-1625 nm but is not a 1490 nm specification), so 0.22 dB/km bridges the two published windows and is not a citation. Why this rung exists: the loose-tube ladder this catalogue shipped (12/24/48/96/144) has no 72, and cableFor's smallest-that-fits rule therefore jumps from 48F to 96F - measured by driving design.cableFor(60, DEFAULT_LADDER, registry), a 60-fibre span is bought as g652d-loose-96, thirty-six fibres of cable nobody asked for, and a 72F is a stocked construction not a special (Belden GBNH872 outdoor multi-loose-tube is 6 tubes of 12 at 72F; Corning's MiniXtend HD 072ZM4 is 72 F (6x12); RDM's CST steel-tape armoured OT6x23CDH is 6 x 12 at 72f). The row reaches a design only when the ladder names it: DEFAULT_LADDER in engine/design.js stops at g652d-loose-144 for loose tube, so pass this model in the design ladder option (the API validates every ladder entry against this catalogue) or add it to the default in an engine change - the part alone does not re-rank existing designs. drumM is 4,000 m and it is a put-up rather than a guess: RDM's OT6x23CDH sheet publishes a standard put-up length of 4,000 m (-1/+5%), Belden's GBNH872 ships on a 4,100 m reel, and Corning's MiniXtend HD 72F spec sheet prints 6,000 m per reel, so 4 km is the smallest published floor for this count and the row keeps it rather than inventing a 2 km drum none of those sheets prints. A 2,500 m run is then one 4 km drum, not two 2 km reels and the joint between them; a run past the reel is quoted whole drums by the engine. Replace all three attenuation figures with the bought cable's test report for a construction-grade budget, and set drumM to the reel actually ordered.
